newsitem.title: USA: Harvard Scientific changes management. [CORRECTED 18:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Harvard Scientific changes management. [CORRECTED 18:40 GMT]

text.p: Harvard Scientific Corp said on Tuesday it has named Ian Hicks as its president and chief executive officer and Don Steffens as its chief financial officer.

The company also said it has appointed an Executive Advisory Committee to assist in the completion of planned operations and an expansion of its core business, and it has relocated its corporate offices from Las Vegas to Reno, Nev.
Hicks replaces Neal Armstrong as president and chief executive officer of Harvard Scientific, a company spokesman said. Armstrong remains on the company's board of directors.
(Company corrects to state that Armstrong retains board seat)
Steffens filled a vacant chief financial officer post, the spokesman said. Armstrong had been the chief financial officer before being named chief executive in June.

In a statement, the company said the management change was necessary to facilitate corporate strategies for gaining approval and market acceptance of the company's treatment for male erectile dysfunction.
The change also was necessary to improve Harvard Scientific's ability to perform its current distribution agreements, the company said.
